authority.basis: Lane E case selection recorded in gaia-research/gaia-research#208 and the review-provenance preparation packet

claims.conditions: An agent is asked to adjudicate a plausible code-review suggestion that reads as safer than it is, in a file that already encodes state-specific nullability, and apply only the justified provenance fix. The reviewer recommendation itself names a blanket rule over every null field.
claims.rationale: The claim under test is that supplying this skill changes whether the agent verifies the recommendation against the implementation and preserves the state-specific invariants, instead of applying the suggestion because it sounds safer. It is a candidate claim admitted so a receipt has something to target; admitting it asserts nothing about its truth.
